title: The Sunscar desert and the waygate
changes: An old sandstone waygate now stands south of Oakvale. It wakes once both the Hollow King and the Hide-Mother of the Mawdeep are beaten.
Walk into the light to cross to the Sunscar, a whole new desert land with dunes, oases, sandstone cliffs and the mud-brick town of Kel Ashar.
Monsters, quests and the desert's story arrive in the next updates.
